changelog:
New:
- ADS FX: scope lens shader on the sight_rear dummy (zoom, fish eye, aberration, vignette, tint, custom shape) + crosshair. Optional lens_top dummy makes it turn with the weapon.
- ADS Sight Recoil, ADS Weapon Tilt and ADS Sway.
- Depth of Field FX for Manual Zoom and Weapon Inspector (requires SimpleDepthBuffer.SA.asi, included).
- BodyCam FX and HUD Visor (Manual Zoom scanner + shoot shake).
- Crash FX for G-Force.
- First Person Availability: Everywhere / On Foot only / In Vehicles only.
- Swimming camera roll.
- Share tab now lists general configs; key detection in the mod menu.
Improvements:
- Gamepad and mouse camera no longer depend on framerate.
- Update check no longer freezes the game.
Fixes:
- Share tab, crouch roll, ADS Kickback at low FPS, On Foot Look Behind.
- Vehicle entry camera direction and vehicle/on-foot transition.
- HUD Visor crash glitch, cinematic camera spin looking straight up/down.
- Player moving while knocked down by a car.
- Cinematic camera staying active after an animation ended.
